# glm.contrasts.ContrastResult { #fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult }

```python
ContrastResult(
    name,
    estimate,
    stat,
    se,
    p_value,
    df,
    stat_type,
    spatial=None,
    intent=None,
    touched_columns=(),
    touched_column_details=(),
    caveats=(),
)
```

Result of evaluating a contrast on GLM output.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name      | Type            | Description                                                                         |
|-----------|-----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| name      | str             | Contrast name.                                                                      |
| estimate  | NDArray         | Contrast estimate ``c' @ B``, shape ``(k, V)`` for F-tests or ``(V,)`` for t-tests. |
| stat      | NDArray         | Test statistic (t or F), shape ``(V,)``.                                            |
| se        | NDArray or None | Standard error, shape ``(V,)`` (t-tests only).                                      |
| p_value   | NDArray         | Two-sided p-values, shape ``(V,)``.                                                 |
| df        | float or tuple  | Degrees of freedom.  Scalar for t-tests, ``(df1, df2)`` for F-tests.                |
| stat_type | str             | ``"t"`` or ``"F"``.                                                                 |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [explain](#fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult.explain) | Return structured explanation data for this contrast result. |
| [summary](#fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult.summary) | Return a JSON-ready structured summary of this contrast. |
| [to_neurovec](#fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult.to_neurovec) | Return a ``neuroim.DenseNeuroVec`` stacking multiple statistics. |
| [to_neurovol](#fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult.to_neurovol) | Return a ``neuroim.DenseNeuroVol`` for one statistic. |
| [to_nifti](#fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult.to_nifti) | Write one statistic to disk as a NIfTI volume. |

### explain { #fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult.explain }

```python
explain()
```

Return structured explanation data for this contrast result.

### summary { #fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult.summary }

```python
summary()
```

Return a JSON-ready structured summary of this contrast.

### to_neurovec { #fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult.to_neurovec }

```python
to_neurovec(kinds=None, *, fill=0.0)
```

Return a ``neuroim.DenseNeuroVec`` stacking multiple statistics.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type            | Description                                                                                                                                                    | Default   |
|--------|-----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| kinds  | sequence of str | Statistic kinds to stack along the 4th dimension. Defaults to ``("estimate", "stat", "p_value")`` for t-contrasts and ``("stat", "p_value")`` for F-contrasts. | `None`    |
| fill   | float           | Out-of-mask fill value (defaults to 0.0).                                                                                                                      | `0.0`     |

### to_neurovol { #fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult.to_neurovol }

```python
to_neurovol(kind='stat', *, fill=0.0, label=None)
```

Return a ``neuroim.DenseNeuroVol`` for one statistic.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                     | Default   |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| kind   | str    | One of ``"stat"`` (default), ``"estimate"``, ``"se"``, ``"p_value"``.                                                           | `'stat'`  |
| fill   | float  | Value placed at non-mask voxels. Defaults to 0.0 so the volume writes cleanly to NIfTI; pass ``np.nan`` for diagnostic display. | `0.0`     |
| label  | str    | Volume label. Defaults to ``f"{self.name}.{kind}"``.                                                                            | `None`    |

### to_nifti { #fmrimod.glm.contrasts.ContrastResult.to_nifti }

```python
to_nifti(path, *, kind='stat', fill=0.0)
```

Write one statistic to disk as a NIfTI volume.

Returns the resolved `pathlib.Path`.
